thesis: The 15-minute swing rules' shape (wide stop, no partial, breakeven at 2R) on hourly bars: a daily-high breakout on above-average volume in an established uptrend. The most active variant with a plausible fee budget.
risks: Alpaca volume is its own venue's thin book, so the volume filter is noisy; breakouts in chop fail fast; the stop is wide relative to hourly noise, so losers are slow.
